routing_warnings.description: The choice between a stamped cover-letter package and stamped marked-up sheets concerns the concurrence deliverable format rather than the substantive review scope.
The requested photographs concern documentation used to verify the completed changes.
The statement that the stamped note was good verifies the stamped concurrence artifact, not independently the limited-review behavior.
The request to stamp omitted detailed callouts concerns the separate schematic-callout deliverable.
This message questions whether the separate permit package includes producing drawings and calculations rather than changing the documentation needed to verify the as-built modifications.
This message selects permissible formats for the stamped concurrence artifact rather than changing the supporting verification documentation.
This message requests stamped schematic callouts and belongs to the independently defined schematic-callout Requirement.
The legal-name placeholder concerns PE identity and signature-block attribution rather than whether the concurrence package is stamped.
The requested date correction belongs to the independently defined document-date-format Requirement.
The same message independently requests stamps on schematic callouts; that clause belongs to the schematic-callout Requirement.
This message specifically requires original-scope callouts to be stamped in a schematic layout.

The client explicitly questions the identity associated with Nevada PE license 47283 in the Nevada as-built concurrence context.

The replacement PE identity and license are supplied in response to the Nevada credential concern and appear to concern the Nevada stamping project rather than the separate California permit-design work.
